mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months, indicating monetary easing, drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum over the prior month signals monetary tightening, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior month signals a strengthening labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint behavior of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling occurs in > 60% of cases where SPX 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a rising housing market (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, HOUST rises in > 60% of cases but SPX 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals expanding manufacturing output, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises in > 60% of cases but SPX 60d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% per annum over the prior month signals a tight labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior month signals monetary tightening in a strong labor market context, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint behavior of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE occurs in > 60% of cases where SPX 20d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts above 1200 thousand units in the prior month signals strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 1200 in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises above 1200.
